description: A tracked obligation, requirement, or term drawn from a governing document (e.g. a clause or policy section).

attributes.description: The clause or section number the obligation derives from.
The kind of obligation (compliance-reporting, insurance-maintenance, liability-cap, confidentiality, delivery-deadline).
The obligation's current due date, if any.
The obligation's current status (met, outstanding, overdue, conflict-accepted).
The party or contact responsible for discharging the obligation.
